system:
You are a promo editor for vertical microdramas (ReelShort/DramaBox style).
You pick which seconds of an episode become a 20-60 second advert for the show.

A good promo:
- opens on a hook: within its first beats, something that stops a scrolling viewer - a slap, a reveal, a shocking line
- ends on a cliffhanger: it stops at an unresolved moment, so the viewer must go find the show
- makes sense alone to someone who has never seen this show

You will be given candidate windows, each a contiguous run of beats labelled [b00], [b01]...
You must choose ONE window and may tighten its edges to any beat labels inside that window.

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "chosen_window": <integer index of the window you picked>,
  "start_beat": "<beat label>",
  "end_beat": "<beat label>",
  "hook_beat": "<beat label, must be at or within 2 beats of start_beat>",
  "cliffhanger_beat": "<beat label, must be at or near end_beat>",
  "hook": "<what grabs the viewer in the first seconds, one sentence>",
  "cliffhanger": "<the unresolved moment it cuts on, one sentence>",
  "hook_type": "<one of: moral outrage, romantic tension, empathy shock, power reversal>",
  "why_it_works": "<one sentence, concrete, no marketing language>",
  "standalone_risk": "<what a new viewer would NOT understand, or 'none'>"
}

Never invent dialogue. Never output a time or a duration - only beat labels.
prompt:
Episode 16. 3 candidate windows, already checked for legal length and real beat boundaries.

--- WINDOW 0 (32 seconds, code score 0.85) ---
[b00] THIRD THUG (desperate, shouting): "Stay back!"
[b01] ACTION: Alexander deflects the strike with his forearm, drives a swift counter-blow into the thug's torso, and spins him violently to the ground.
[b02] SFX: Solid bone-and-fist impact followed by a groaning thud.
[b03] JULIANA (breathless, overwhelmed): "Alexander..."
[b04] ALEXANDER (gentle, concerned): "Are you hurt?"
[b05] JULIANA (fragile, pain-filled): "Only my hands."
[b06] ACTION: Alexander lifts the thug onto his tiptoes against the cottage wall, glaring with lethal intensity.
[b07] ALEXANDER (demanding, threatening): "Who sent you?"
[b08] THUG WITH CAP (choking, defiant): "No one!"
[b09] ALEXANDER (cold, ominous): "Wrong answer."
[b10] ACTION: Alexander tightens his grip on the thug's throat, lifting him higher against the stone wall.
[b11] ALEXANDER (roaring): "Who?!"
[b12] THUG WITH CAP (screaming, panicked): "Harrington! Gerald Harrington paid us!"
[b13] JULIANA (shaken, heartbroken): "Gerald..."
[b14] ACTION: The Thug with Cap scrambles to his feet and sprints into the dark woods alongside his two limping accomplices.
[b15] THUG WITH CAP (shouting, retreating): "We were only paid to destroy the garden, that's all!"

--- WINDOW 1 (21 seconds, code score 0.84) ---
[b00] THUG WITH CAP (furious, shouting): "I said, move!"
[b01] JULIANA (frightened, whispering): "Alexander..."
[b02] ALEXANDER (calm, protective): "Stay behind me."
[b03] THUG WITH CAP (roaring): "Aaargh!"
[b04] ACTION: The thug swings the club down with full force, but Alexander catches the weapon mid-air in his bare hand with chilling ease.
[b05] SFX: Heavy blunt impact of a solid hand gripping wood.
[b06] ACTION: Alexander strikes the thug across the chest and slams him violently into the muddy ground beside the stone wall.
[b07] SFX: Heavy thud of a body crashing into soil and wood.
[b08] BALD THUG (yelling): "Aaargh!"
[b09] SFX: Loud wooden scrape and crunch as the Bald Thug slides across the planks into the fence.
[b10] THIRD THUG (desperate, shouting): "Stay back!"
[b11] ACTION: Alexander deflects the strike with his forearm, drives a swift counter-blow into the thug's torso, and spins him violently to the ground.
[b12] SFX: Solid bone-and-fist impact followed by a groaning thud.

--- WINDOW 2 (37 seconds, code score 0.69) ---
[b00] ALEXANDER (cold, ominous): "Wrong answer."
[b01] ACTION: Alexander tightens his grip on the thug's throat, lifting him higher against the stone wall.
[b02] ALEXANDER (roaring): "Who?!"
[b03] THUG WITH CAP (screaming, panicked): "Harrington! Gerald Harrington paid us!"
[b04] JULIANA (shaken, heartbroken): "Gerald..."
[b05] ACTION: The Thug with Cap scrambles to his feet and sprints into the dark woods alongside his two limping accomplices.
[b06] THUG WITH CAP (shouting, retreating): "We were only paid to destroy the garden, that's all!"
[b07] ACTION: Alexander flexes his bleeding hand, showing no sign of pain.
[b08] JULIANA (soft, astounded): "You knew exactly what to do."
[b09] JULIANA (wondering, intrigued): "You fought like you've done this a hundred times."
[b10] ALEXANDER (somber, heavy-hearted): "A soldier learns things he wishes he could forget."
[b11] JULIANA (tender, concerned): "Are you hurt?"
[b12] ACTION: Juliana reaches out toward his injured hand with delicate concern.
[b13] ALEXANDER (quiet, steady): "No."
[b14] ACTION: Alexander and Juliana gaze deeply into each other's eyes, an unspoken bond forming between them as the ruined garden lies silent beneath the moon.
[b15] SFX: Slow, resonant emotional cello melody swelling to a dramatic cliffhanger hold.

Pick the single best promo.
